create_table_google_docs.description: Formats and pastes a rich HTML/TSV table directly into Google Docs or a web document in Chrome.

create_table_word.description: Creates and populates a native formatted table in Microsoft Word via COM automation.

tile_windows.description: Tiles two open applications side-by-side (50% left, 50% right) on the screen.

parameters.left_app: Application name to position on the left (e.g. 'notepad')
parameters.right_app: Application name to position on the right (e.g. 'chrome')

tile_all_active_windows.description: Detects all open, visible non-minimized application windows on the primary display and tiles them evenly side by side across the desktop work area.

set_formatted_html_to_clipboard.description: Set formatted HTML to clipboard and send Ctrl+V via ctypes

download_rhino_srv_image_and.description: Download Rhino SRV image and paste into Google Doc via clipboard DIB

insert_dss_heatmap_heading_and.description: Insert DSS heatmap heading and image into Google Doc

test_fetching_actual_surface_mining.description: Test fetching actual surface mining and rig images

update_google_doc_with_accurate.description: Update Google Doc with accurate surface mining details, images, and new DSS site info

inspect_youtube_thumbnails_for_surface.description: Inspect YouTube thumbnails for surface scanning and hotspot details

append_yellow_hotspots_and_purple.description: Append Yellow Hotspots and Purple Scanner Seams section and image
